instruction:
Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-09_input.step. To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). Use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-09_input.step`.

Keep the 170 x 74 x 10 mm outside plate. Cut three through obround slots along X: center (38,20), length 30 mm, width 8 mm; center (86,20), length 36 mm, width 8 mm; and center (134,20), length 30 mm, width 8 mm. Cut two through obround slots along Y: center (58,54), length 34 mm, width 7 mm; and center (118,54), length 28 mm, width 9 mm. Cut three ordinary vertical through holes: diameter 6 mm at (20,54), diameter 6 mm at (150,54), and diameter 8 mm at (86,54). Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-09_output.step.
